name: google-messages-for-desktop
description: Google Messages desktop wrapper. Windows: Chromium App Host with sms:/tel: handlers; mac/linux: Nativefier.

scripts.package:windows: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/windows/build-installer.ps1 -AppRoot dist/Windows_Host -SkipCompile && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; if(Test-Path dist/google-messages-windows-host_v1.5.0.zip){Remove-Item dist/google-messages-windows-host_v1.5.0.zip -Force}; [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::CreateFromDirectory('dist/Windows_Tray_Payload','dist/google-messages-windows-host_v1.5.0.zip')"
scripts.build:all: npm run clean:dist && npm run mac && npm run windows:host && npm run linux
scripts.package:all: npm run package:mac && npm run package:linux && npm run package:windows
scripts.release: npm run build:all && npm run package:all

author: Kelvin Nguyen
